# ZMK files used by the tests

Unmodified copies from [zmkfirmware/zmk](https://github.com/zmkfirmware/zmk)
at commit `9ebbeff0a8b69a42f14aec022cdf16c7a107b9e0`, kept in ZMK's own folder layout
so that `#include <layouts/...>` resolves the same way it does for files downloaded from ZMK.
They are MIT licensed; see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

- `app/boards/shields/corne/` — the Corne shield and its stock keymap
- `app/dts/layouts/foostan/corne/` — the shared 5- and 6-column Corne layouts
